subject: trophy room
fact: The trophy room contains a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers, some of which are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves.
source_quote: Only a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers remain. Zinia, who enters the room, looks more carefully and realizes that some of the trophies are the heads of dwarves, humans, and elves

subject: domicile of the majordomo
fact: The domicile of the majordomo is stripped of anything valuable.
source_quote: The next door on the southern wall opens into the domicile of the majordomo of the castle. Zephyr sighs; it’s stripped of anything valuable

subject: westernmost hallway end
fact: The room at the westernmost end of the hallway is partially collapsed, and the remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort.
source_quote: From there, Zephyr opens the westernmost door, where the hallway ends. Much like the other parts of the castle, this room is partially collapsed. The remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort

subject: intact chest
fact: An intact chest is located at the south end of the room, and a giant lizard was using it as a lure.
source_quote: Zephyr notices an intact chest at the south end of the room. As he approaches it, he notices a giant lizard just in time. The lizard was using the chest as a lure

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down.
source_quote: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down

subject: swarm of rats
fact: The room has a swarm of rats that are quickly killed.
source_quote: It also has a swarm of rats. Rats that are quickly killed

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer turns to the group, 'I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us.'
source_quote: Calmer turns to the group, "I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south.
source_quote: Sequoia agrees. They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors. The hallway runs north-south

subject: old conference room chamber
fact: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, 'Nothing to be found.'
source_quote: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, "Nothing to be found."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia mutters, 'And for door number two,' as he opens the next door on the western wall.
source_quote: Sequoia mutters, "And for door number two," as he opens the next door on the western wall

subject: bed chamber for a lowly official
fact: In the chamber behind the second door, there is what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official.
source_quote: And in this chamber, he finds what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official

subject: salon for meetings
fact: Across the hallway, another door is opened, revealing a room in shambles with missing things, but whatever remains still appears valuable. He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless. He looks around and mutters, 'A salon for meetings?'
source_quote: Across the hallway, he sees another door and excitedly opens it. He looks inside, and although the room is in shambles and things are missing, whatever remains still appears valuable. He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless. He looks around and mutters, "A salon for meetings?"

subject: large chamber at the end of the hallway
fact: The large chamber at the end of the hallway is empty of anything valuable, but has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails. Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
source_quote: Leaving the salon and reentering the hallway, he walks into the large chamber at the end of the hallway. Much like other parts of the moathouse, this room is empty of anything valuable. Unlike other rooms, this room has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails. Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
